answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie each identity to a scarce, verifiable cost that cannot be faked at scale: require a stake locked in escrow plus a unique hardware-backed attestation, so a hollow shell account with no history earns nothing. Like water filtering through karst, reputation should flow only through real, paid interactions -- each transaction leaves a trace that a mirror copy of an identity cannot reproduce. Peers then attest only identities whose stake and interaction graph check out, making mass fake identities economically pointless.
